key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: Water fluoridation isn't about healthy teeth; it's about societal control.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: The rise of fluoridation coincided with the development of mass media and increasingly sophisticated methods of social control.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Established a link between fluoridation and broader concerns about government overreach.

key_persuasion_moments.speaker: CA
key_persuasion_moments.excerpt: The question isn't whether fluoride harms teeth, but why governments are so insistent on adding it to our water.
key_persuasion_moments.why_it_mattered: Challenged the assumed benefits of fluoridation and highlighted the motivations behind it.
